system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

While the blood of the Senju runs through you, the heritage of one burns brightest. You have access to the unique Mokuton Kekkei Genkai and it suffuses itself throughout your already varied forms of combat. This is represented by your Mokuton Infusion Chakra stance. Unlike other chakra stances, you can benefit from this Chakra stance and either a Taijutsu stance or a Bukijutsu stance, at the same time.

You can enter the Mokuton Infusion stance as a bonus action, when you do, select one of its variants. You can swap between these variants by spending a bonus action on subsequent turns.

Will of the Buddha. While in this variant stance, you gain the following benefits:

When you take the attack action while you wield a Combat Scroll you can choose to instead make Verdant Lash attacks. You can replace each attack you would make as part of the Attack action with a Verdant Lash attack.

Verdant Lash. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see, lashing out with bramble strikes. On a hit, you deal the listed melee or ranged damage. If you roll an 8 or higher on the damage die of this attack, you inflict 1 rank of Drained and push or pull them 10 feet closer or further from you. This increases to 15 feet, 2 ranks of Drained and this attack is treated as casting a D-Rank Hijutsu at 7th level. Increase the damage dealt by +1 damage die at 11th level. Starting at 15th level, increase the ranks of Drained inflicted to 3.

Melee: 1d10 + your Jutsu ability modifier in Earth, Cold or Chakra damage.

Ranged: 30 feet, 1d10 Earth, Cold or Chakra damage.

Fist of Hevajra. While in this variant stance, you gain the following benefits:

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes Cold, Earth or Chakra which you choose when you roll damage.

Your unarmed attacks can use your Hijutsu Flexibility trait to calculate its attack and damage rolls.

Your unarmed attacks gain the Reach 1 weapon property as your strikes are followed by branching wood strikes. This increases to Reach 2 at 7th level.
